```{python}
import json, pandas as pd, yaml
from pathlib import Path
REL = Path("../data/release")
schema = yaml.safe_load(open("../docs/schema.yaml"))
obs = pd.read_csv(REL / "observations.csv", parse_dates=["survey_date"])
qa = pd.read_csv(REL / "qa_summary.csv")
meta = json.loads((REL / "metadata.json").read_text())
passed = obs[obs["qa_flag"].isna()]
```

## Abstract
<!-- 3-4 sentences: what, where, when, how many records, where the data lives. -->

## Methods
**Survey design.** <!-- reaches, landmarks, walk direction, visual count protocol -->

**Data collection.** Survey123 form with coded domains, conditional required fields,
range constraints, and a `{python} schema["gps_accuracy_warn_m"]` m GPS accuracy threshold.

**Quality control.** Automated post-collection checks (`scripts/qa_pipeline.py`):

```{python}
qa[qa["n"] > 0][["check", "n", "description"]]
```

## Results

```{python}
tbl = (passed[passed["obs_type"].isin(["live_fish", "carcass"])]
       .pivot_table(index="reach", columns="species", values="count",
                    aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0))
tbl if len(tbl) else "No live fish or carcasses recorded in QA-passed records (zero counts are valid)."
```
